notes.title: FILF V1.0b
notes.content:
What's New:

- Story content that focuses on all characters
- Around 700 new images
- Around 40 new animations
- Fixed an issue that displayed some images wrong on Samantha's morning breast-job in her bedroom.

FILF may be coming to a close, but FILF2 is on the way. Enjoy!

notes.title: FILF V0.18b Update
notes.content:
What's New:
- Two New Cotton Candi/Jackie scenes (Strip Club and Night Club)
- Added in Jackie's stripper scene with the Cotton Candi Model
- New Samantha scene at the pool, 15 stories needed
- New option during the gym shower scene with Samantha/Courtney
- Added one quick animation to the first gym shower scene
- Added the last story progressed scene before Election Day at City Hall
- Removed Possible Content Placeholder options at the gym and camsite
- Removed the Straw Poll from the map's UI
- Fixed a bug that could trigger Samantha/Courtney's porno with you earlier in the 
     questline than it should have.
- Fixed a bug that let you do choose between Diane/Delia BEFORE hitting all the key 
     requirements of story so it makes sense.
- A possible fix for the bug that halted progress when returning items at the spa
- Fixed a few "!" guides that displayed when they shouldn't.
- Lots of Spelling/Grammar fixes through the game including wrongly labeled 
     character named text

notes.title: FILF V0.17c - Content Update!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

I have another round of new content for you. Enjoy!

- New option with Melissa at the Massage Parlor

- New secret photo to find and unlock (two variants)
- Re-rendered the Coffee Bar as needed for new imagebuttons
- Fixed a few bugs in the gallery and other places

- Some small grammar/spelling fixes

notes.title: FILF V0.15
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

     I have another update for you with some new scene content and some helpful additions

What's New:
- Quest Guide System via the Map! Don't know what to do? Look around for
    the "!" on the overworld map to know if there something you need to do
         within that location/time.
- 6 New Scenes. 3 for Aubrey and 3 for Courtney
- Reduced the price for the "disguise" slightly

Enjoy!
